Trigger an asynchronous infrastructure investigation report.

IMPORTANT:
- This tool consumes 1 AI credit per use.
- Reports are generated in the background and CANNOT be modified once triggered.
- Before calling this tool, gather ALL necessary context from the user: time range,
  specific servers/nodes, areas of interest, and any symptoms or issues to analyze.
- The user will be notified via email when the report is complete, and can view it
  in the Netdata Cloud UI at: https://app.netdata.cloud/spaces/<space-slug>/rooms/<room-slug>/insights/reports/<report_id>

Use the get_profile tool first to obtain the space_id and room_id.
Note: Requires a business plan.
